spans.s: युष्मदीय [yuṣmadīya], a. Your, yours. -यः A countryman of yours; Ratn.

युष्मद् [yuṣmad], The base of the second personal pronoun; (nom. त्वम्, युवाम्, यूयम्) Thou, you; (at the beginning of several compounds). -Comp. -अर्थम् ind. for you.-आयत्त a. at your disposal. -वाच्यम् (in gram.) the second person. -विध a. like you.
युष्मादृश् [yuṣmādṛś] श [ś], श a. Like you.
यूषः [yūṣḥ] षम् [ṣam] यूषन् [yūṣan], षम् यूषन् m., n. Soup, broth, pease-soup. (यूषन् has no forms for the first five inflections, and is optionally substituted for यूष after acc. dual.)
यूष् [yūṣ], 1 P. (यूषति) To injure, kill, hurt.
